title: By six months, most babies reach to grab a toy they want
summary: The CDC says that by six months, most babies reach to grab a toy they want.
body: The CDC's six-month cognitive list says a baby reaches to grab a toy she wants. The line is a reach aimed at a wanted toy. It is what the US page says most babies do by six months. It does not measure the length of the reach.

sources.title: Milestones by 6 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US CDC page, public domain. Updated and reviewed 16 May 2026. Supports the cognitive item 'Reaches to grab a toy she wants.'
